data.description:
Browser tests: hand-first click flow for upgrades

**Priority: High** | **Type: Task** | **Parent: CG-0MT3IYSRL001VVUP**

## Problem statement

Browser tests to verify the upgrade hand-first click flow before implementation. These tests should initially fail (red) and pass after F-2 implementation (green).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Click a market upgrade card: moves to hand, consumes 1 action, card NOT auto-selected (pendingHandIndex null), uiPhase reverts to 'market'.
- Click the same-day moved upgrade in hand: sets pendingHandIndex, switches to 'placing-from-hand' state.
- Click an eligible street business: upgrade applies, pendingHandIndex resets, uiPhase returns to 'market'. Same-day composite does NOT consume additional action.
- Click a held (previous-day) upgrade in hand: sets pendingHandIndex, switches to 'placing-from-hand'. Clicking eligible business consumes 1 action.
- Click ineligible business: illegal-move feedback (shake), upgrade stays selected, player must click another target.
- Market upgrade cards show premium label and dim when action budget is spent.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` — `onUpgradeCardClick`, `onHandUpgradeCardClick`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts` — draggable upgrades, premium label, budget dimming
- `tests/main-street/upgrade-hand-flow.browser.test.ts` — new browser test file

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none (test-first)
- Blocks: F-2 (Engine: implement hand-first click flow)

## Deliverables

- New browser test file with failing tests for all 6 ACs
- Tests pass after implementation of F-2

data.comment:
Implemented the upgrade hand-first click flow (test-first, TDD cycle completed in-session so the suite stays green).

## What changed
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts: rewrote onUpgradeCardClick (market click now MOVES the upgrade to hand via moveToHandCommand, spends 1 action, no auto-select, uiPhase reverts to 'market'); added onHandUpgradeCardClick (selects the hand upgrade, sets pendingHandIndex, enters 'placing-from-hand', derives pendingHandJustMoved from state.justMovedUpgradeCardId); added applyHandUpgradeToSlot (business-target eligibility = targetBusiness + requiredLevel + below maxLevel; ineligible => illegal-move feedback, no mutation, upgrade stays selected); onSlotClick branches to upgrade targeting with 'apply-upgrade' tutorial gating; onHandBusinessCardClick delegates upgrade indices.
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts: upgrades are now action-gated (dim at 0 actions, alpha 0.45) and show the buy-and-place premium badge (same formula/name as business); hand rendering has an upgrade branch dispatching to onHandUpgradeCardClick; every market card container is named up-front so dimmed click-only cards stay locatable.
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts: added onHandUpgradeCardClick scene proxy.
- tests/main-street/upgrade-hand-flow.browser.test.ts (NEW): 7 behaviour tests for all 6 ACs (move-to-hand spends 1 action + stays unselected; hand click enters targeting; same-day composite is free; held play spends 1 action; ineligible target keeps selection; premium badge + budget dimming; market click rejected at 0 actions).
- tests/main-street/illegal-afford-feedback.test.ts + upgrade-level-up.browser.test.ts: updated for the new flow (upgrade cost is charged at play, so the market click is coin-free; level-up test now drives market click -> hand click -> slot click). These are the existing-test updates owned by CG-0MT42HHAB000VJUK, done here because they were required to keep the suite green.

## Verification
- npx tsc --noEmit: clean
- unit tests/main-street/: 3071 passed | 3 skipped
- npm run test:smoke: 107 passed
- upgrade-targeted browser tests: 8 passed

## Assumptions / notes
- Drag-drop buy-and-play for upgrades (F-3, CG-0MT40FT21005GBK7) is NOT implemented here; only the market premium badge was added per this item's AC6.
- GDD/README/help-text documentation remains with CG-0MT42HHAB000VJUK.
